verdict.rationale: Evidence shows tag-based search syntax (implying tags can be attached) and a changelog note about 'event context' and 'event correlation' configuration in JS packages, but there is no explicit documentation of breadcrumb trails or explicit user-context attachment on error notices. missing for 10: explicit breadcrumb API/docs, explicit user context attachment API, worked example showing tags+context+breadcrumbs together on a single event.
